summary: Iteration 16 — Both deployment-readiness fixes VERIFIED end-to-end. FIX 1 (non-destructive expired-group cleanup, backend): 16/16 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_expired_soft_delete.py. LIVE PURGE — one live purge run (after backend restart to reset the 30s in-process throttle) SOFT-deletes 3 seeded past-date groups in a single tick: (a) they disappear from GET /api/groups, (b) DB doc STILL exists with status=='expired' AND expired_at set, (c) a co-located future-date group remains visible and gets NO status field, (d) 2 messages seeded inside the first past group are STILL in db.messages after the purge (no destructive delete_many on messages), (e) GET /api/groups/{id} for a soft-deleted group STILL returns 200 (deep-link/chat-history/admin surface preserved per spec). FEED FILTER — pre-seeded status='expired' groups are excluded from GET /api/groups but visible from GET /api/groups/{id}. /api/groups/mine FILTER — expired groups excluded from BOTH 'created' AND 'joined' lists; regular future groups appear correctly; owner-vs-joiner routing regression still holds. FIX 2 (splash asset path, frontend): app.json:43 uses ./assets/images/splash-image.png which exists in /app/frontend/assets/images/ (verified via ls). Restarted expo — Metro logs show ZERO asset-resolution errors, ZERO splash-icon references, and https://social-activities-3.preview.emergentagent.com/ returns 200. The only Metro output is pre-existing 'expo@54.0.35 vs expected ~54.0.37' compat warnings unrelated to this fix. REGRESSIONS — 20/20 iteration 15 gender-filter tests still pass; 16/16 iteration 14 google-auth tests still pass; T&C join gate still returns 403 for terms=null users; cascade DELETE /api/auth/me returns 200 and invalidates the session token; missing Bearer → 401, malformed Bearer → 401, bogus well-formed token → 401. Total: 52/52 backend tests across the three suites (100%). Pre-existing stale suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_reports_admin.py still uses device-UUID Bearer tokens from before iteration 14 auth migration and fails wholesale with 401 — this is a documented stale-test issue (see iteration_15 context) NOT caused by our fix.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:667-692 _purge_expired_groups — correctly uses update_many with {$set:{status:'expired',expired_at:now}} instead of delete_many; the cursor pre-filter {status:{$ne:'expired'}} makes the operation idempotent so subsequent throttled invocations skip already-processed docs.

server.py:1112 GET /api/groups — {status:{$ne:'expired'}} correctly EXCLUDES docs missing the status field entirely (Mongo $ne semantics treat missing==null!=='expired'), which is what we want for backward compatibility with pre-fix groups.

server.py:1148-1156 GET /api/groups/mine — same predicate applied to both created and joined pipelines, and correctly still enforces owner_id!=$user for the joined list so owners don't get duplicated.

server.py:1166-1170 GET /api/groups/{id} — deliberately does NOT filter status:'expired' so chat history / deep links / admin panel keep working, per the spec. Verified this is intentional and matches the PR description.
app.json:43 splash-image.png path — asset exists on disk. Bundler starts cleanly (no ENOENT).

Throttling caveat (informational): _purge_expired_groups has a 30s in-process throttle. In tests we work around it by restarting the backend once at module start. In production this means an event that expires at 12:00:00 may take up to ~5min (throttle interval) to be soft-deleted from the feed — this matches the pre-fix behavior and is not a regression.

Key nuance: _purge_expired_groups has a 30-second in-process throttle (_PURGE_MIN_INTERVAL_S=30 at server.py:632), so pytest-level tests can only observe ONE live purge per backend process; the test module fixture restarts the backend to reset this.
